name: Login URL Discovery
description: Finds the login/authentication page URL for an AI provider by scanning links, classifying pages, and verifying reachability.
systemPrompt: You are a classification assistant. Analyze the provided page content and classify it into exactly one of the allowed answers. Return JSON with 'answer', 'observation' (one short sentence), and optional 'confidence'.
task: Find the login/authentication page URL for {providerName}.

init-state.name: Initialize State
init-state.description: Initializes the verification state from the current research data.

is-self-hosted.name: Is Self-Hosted Provider
is-self-hosted.description: Checks whether the provider is self-hosted (local application without web-based login).

record-current-fact.name: Record Current Fact
record-current-fact.description: Records the current field value as a verified fact in the research state.

scan-provider-links.name: Scan Provider Links
scan-provider-links.description: Scans the provider website for candidate URLs matching the field purpose.

has-candidates.name: Has Candidates
has-candidates.description: Checks whether any candidate URLs remain to be evaluated.

fetch-next-candidate.name: Fetch Next Candidate
fetch-next-candidate.description: Fetches the next candidate URL from the queue for evaluation.

classify-page.name: Classify Page
classify-page.description: Uses the LLM to classify the fetched page content against the field purpose.
classify-page.task: Classify this page for the field purpose: finding the login/authentication page URL for {{providerName}}. Is this a login/authentication page, the homepage, an unrelated page, or not relevant? Base your answer on what the page content itself is about. Navigation links and links to other pages may be signals but do not define what this page IS; prefer the page's own content and links directly relevant to logging in or authentication. In your observation, always begin with the candidate URL (the lastFetchedUrl value from State) so the reader knows which page was classified.

verify-reachable.name: Verify Reachable
verify-reachable.description: Verifies that the candidate URL is reachable via HTTP.

is-reachable.name: Is Reachable
is-reachable.description: Checks whether the last reachability verification succeeded.

candidates-exhausted.name: Candidates Exhausted
candidates-exhausted.description: Checks whether any queued candidate is still untried in this run.

web-search.name: Web Search
web-search.description: Searches the web for relevant URLs as a fallback strategy.

has-search-results.name: Has Search Results
has-search-results.description: Checks whether the web search produced a candidate that is still untried.

win.name: Success
win.description: Terminal node indicating a successful result.

lose.name: Failure
lose.description: Terminal node indicating no result was found.

not-applicable.name: Not Applicable
not-applicable.description: Terminal node indicating loginUrl is not applicable for self-hosted providers.
